text:
amanda-cho: quick question — for the console rollout UX, how should we surface the "fallback-handshake" behavior when a tenant has Dedicated capacity + hosted fallback? i.e. route header affinity + cb triggers + preferred backup model. cc @ryan-kal @sophie-liu
ryan-kal: i'd like a single toggle for the handshake mode (strict|graceful|disabled) + a small details panel that shows the route precedence and headers used for affinity. default to graceful for tenants with reserved capacity.
sophie-liu: telemetry needs: emit an event when we switch lanes (hosted->fallback) with reason code (CB_OPEN, NO_CAPACITY, LATENCY_P99). also include what model variant was chosen and the tenant quota window. we should correlate with per-route token counts.
mike-brooks: agree. console should show a simulated probe button that runs the same probe used by the router and returns: latency, success, selected-model. a slider for cb threshold (error pct) + a preview of the fallback chain order.
amanda-cho: prototype idea: expose header overrides in the route editor as read-only hints (e.g. X-Route-Affinity, X-Handshake) and allow per-tenant override only if they have dedicated capacity. show a small badge if the route will include a fallback handshake at deploy.
ryan-kal: implementation note: router needs a deterministic merge order: explicit route header match > tenant affinity header > signed-tenant header > global default. fallback_handshake controls whether we probe backup model before failing upstream. default probe timeout 200ms, probe window 3 attempts.
sophie-liu: for telemetry naming, propose: router.fallback.switch and router.fallback.probe_result. fields: tenant_id, route, reason, chosen_variant, probe_latency_ms, cb_state. also include rollout_id if this was triggered by a canary rule.
mike-brooks: console UX: show a histogram of fallback_events per hour on the route page and a link to the probe logs (last 24h). allow quick rollback of fallback_order in case a backup model regresses.
amanda-cho: can we have a minimal route config example for docs?
ryan-kal: yep — something like:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "match": {"method": "POST", "path": "/v1/generate"},
  "fallback_handshake": "graceful",
  "fallback_chain": [
    {"type": "model_variant", "name": "redwood-medium-q4", "priority": 80},
    {"type": "cached_response", "name": "prefix-kv", "priority": 20}
  ],
  "circuit_breaker": {"error_rate_pct": 5, "window_s": 60},
  "headers": {"x-route-affinity": "tenant", "x-handshake": "auto"}
}
```
ryan-kal: router will honor `x-handshake: force` to bypass probes (for debug) and `x-handshake: disable` to never fallback for a request. these should be rate-limited and logged.
deploy-bot: probe started for route /v1/generate on tenant t-485, fallback_handshake=graceful, probe_id=pb-202603, status=OK, latency_ms=172
sophie-liu: nice — can we make the console annotate the probe event with the CB state at the time (OPEN/CLOSED/HALF)? helps triage.
mike-brooks: also need a way to pin a backup variant for a tenant (tenant override) from the console — not global. UX: small 'pin' icon next to variant in the fallback chain.
amanda-cho: sounds good. next steps: ryan to open a small PR for route schema + probe fields, sophie to add telemetry spec, mike to prototype the console panel. i'll whip up a quick mock and post it here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
